categories.title: Unit tests
categories.description: Isolated Soroban `Env` per test; exercises getters/setters and edge values without randomness.

categories.title: Integration tests
categories.description: Separate test crate binary; longer multi-step flows against the same contract client pattern.

categories.title: Deterministic property sweep
categories.description: Structured many-case check (here: 0..100) proving set/get agreement without a random seed.

categories.title: Randomized property (Proptest)
categories.description: Random `u32` inputs each run; shrinks on failure. Demonstrates property-style testing on Soroban.

categories.title: Invariant tests
categories.description: State consistency: last-write wins per slot, plus cross-slot isolation (writes to one key must not clobber another).

categories.title: libFuzzer (cargo-fuzz)
categories.description: Byte-oriented fuzzing of `set`/`get` in a dedicated harness — not part of `cargo test`. Run `make fuzz` for a smoke run.

categories.title: LLVM coverage
categories.description: Line/function instrumentation and HTML/LCOV reports. Shown on this page when `coverage-summary.json` is present.

externalRuns.name: storage_set_get
externalRuns.cli: cd contracts/basic-storage/fuzz && cargo fuzz run storage_set_get -- -runs=1000
externalRuns.description: Interprets random bytes as a little-endian `u32`, calls `set`/`get`, asserts equality. Exercises the same contract invariants under arbitrary bytes.
externalRuns.note: Not run by this script. Execute locally or in a job with `cargo-fuzz` and LLVM fuzzer deps installed.

suites.name: Library tests
suites.description: Unit, property sweep, Proptest random cases, and several invariant checks (per-slot last-write and cross-slot isolation) in the library test module.
suites.tail:
test test::fuzz_set_get_random_u32 ... ok

test result: ok. 14 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out; finished in 1.13s

tests.name: test::get_returns_zero_before_first_set
tests.detail: Fresh contract: `get()` returns 0 before any `set` (default storage).

tests.name: test::sequential_sets_overwrite_previous_value
tests.detail: Two writes in order; final `get` matches the last written value.

tests.name: test::set_max_u32_get_roundtrip
tests.detail: Boundary: stores and reads `u32::MAX` through the primary slot.

tests.name: test::set_tag_get_roundtrip
tests.detail: String storage + events path: `set_tag` / `get_tag` with Soroban `String`.

tests.name: test::set_then_get_roundtrip_known_value
tests.detail: Writes 42 via `set`, reads back with `get` — basic round-trip.

tests.name: test::property_set_get_roundtrip_for_many_values
tests.detail: Deterministic sweep: for each value in 0..100, `set` then `get` must match (property-style, fixed cases).

tests.name: test::invariant_signed_last_write_visible_on_get_signed
tests.detail: Invariant: random `i32` sequence via `set_signed`; `get_signed()` always equals the last written signed value (Proptest).

tests.name: test::invariant_counter_last_write_visible_on_get_counter
tests.detail: Invariant: random `u64` sequence via `set_counter`; `get_counter()` always equals the last counter write (Proptest).

tests.name: test::invariant_last_write_visible_on_get
tests.detail: Invariant: after a non-empty sequence of random `set`s, `get()` equals the last written value (Proptest, vec length 1–39).

tests.name: test::invariant_signed_unchanged_under_primary_only_writes
tests.detail: Cross-slot: fix signed with `set_signed(anchor)`, then only `set` on primary; `get_signed()` stays `anchor` while `get()` follows last-write wins (Proptest).

tests.name: test::invariant_primary_unchanged_under_signed_only_writes
tests.detail: Cross-slot: fix primary with `set(anchor)`, then only `set_signed` updates; `get()` stays `anchor` while `get_signed()` follows last-write wins (Proptest).

tests.name: test::fuzz_set_get_random_u32
tests.detail: Proptest: 256 random `u32` values; each case `set`/`get` must agree (randomized property).
